(a) widen Write allowlist in agents/settings.json and/or .claude/settings.local.json to cover Write(/opt/itmlogic/agents/**), Write(/opt/itmlogic/agents/state/**), Write(/opt/itmlogic/agents/reports/**) plus Edit equivalents; (b) add fail-loud post-condition in agents/scripts/run-agent.sh that exits non-zero when agents/<agent>/last-findings.json is missing OR head_sha != git rev-parse HEAD. Dedup hashes 9b5e73bc (PMP-001) and 1d7be7be (DSO-005) collapse into this single root cause — bump seen_count, do NOT re-file.
tests_required: for f in agents/*/last-findings.json; do node agents/scripts/validate-findings-json.js "$f"; done
jq -r .head_sha agents/*/last-findings.json | sort -u  # exactly one SHA == git HEAD
